tasks.dev: deno task client:build && deno run --env-file=.env --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write=./data --allow-run --allow-env scripts/dev.ts
tasks.start: deno task client:build && deno run --env-file=.env --allow-net --allow-read=. --allow-env server/main.ts
tasks.check: deno task client:build && deno check web/index.tsx server/main.ts supabase/functions/credit-cards/index.ts scripts/*.ts tests/*.ts
tasks.test: deno task client:build && deno test --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read=. tests/
tasks.build: deno task client:build && deno run --allow-read=dist --allow-write=dist --allow-env=API_BASE_URL scripts/build.ts
tasks.client:build: deno run --allow-read=dist --allow-write=dist scripts/clean-dist.ts && deno bundle --platform browser --outdir dist --external=*.css web/index.html && deno run --allow-read=web --allow-write=dist scripts/copy-assets.ts
